scope: Static probe of the already retained dirty-parent product image; not a new source, full native, registry, deployment or release qualification.

scanner.name: syft
scanner.config_yaml:
check-for-app-update: false
license:
  content: all
file:
  metadata:
    selection: owned-by-package
    digests: [sha256]
  content:
    skip-files-above-size: 1048576
    globs:
      - /usr/share/doc/**/copyright
      - /usr/share/common-licenses/**

findings: Maintained dpkg/ELF catalogers identify installed native packages and Rust dynamic OpenSSL imports independently of Cargo binding versions.
All 104 captured package-root copyright files, one example copyright file and 14 common licence files match actual stopped-image bytes, decoded Syft content and SPDX file checksums.
Parsed SPDX licence identifiers and extracted licence blocks do not preserve every complete Debian copyright document; actual raw notice bytes remain authoritative.
Do not infer compiled-library licence selection from a mixed upstream Debian source copyright inventory.
This probe does not cover unreported static Node/V8 components, private clients host libraries, other images or upstream source provenance.
All 106 installed Debian packages link to one or more of the independently byte-verified full copyright documents.

The pinned private Node executables expose macOS system/framework and Linux C/C++ runtime imports in maintained static metadata. The two PE scans provide no import lists and cannot close Windows host-library coverage. No foreign executable was run.
source_review_blocker: Official pinned Node source-tree downloads failed twice with TLS connection timeouts; ncrypto and unreported/transitive Node/V8 build/notice review remain pending. Existing full Node licences and supplementary notices are retained without inventing coverage.
next_action: Review the source/notice gaps, then record the necessary narrow architecture choice before extending existing product image/SBOM reports with installed package identities, actual raw notice hashes and dynamic library checks. Reuse Syft and existing file readers; do not add a custom scanner, formatter, service or release sidecar. Plugin/chart and other-image coverage follow before vulnerability/publisher policy.
